checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'web-design'.

checks.description: Names the two sub-skills it routes to and the order.
checks.rule: Body names web-experience-direction first (direction) then web-design-spec (build-ready spec) as the sub-skills it routes to.

checks.description: Names the web-design-package with its exact body fields.
checks.rule: Body lists the web-design-package fields information_architecture, ux_flow, wireframe, visual_direction, web_asset_brief, conversion_intent, design_spec, web_design_qa, matching runtime/handoff-contract.md.

checks.description: Names the gate stack before advance: each sub-skill eval, then web-design-qa, then brand-qa.
checks.rule: Body states each sub-skill skill eval runs, then web-design-qa on the spec, then brand-qa-reviewer, with compliance-privacy at the page in conversion-engineer.

checks.description: Forbids baking Arabic text into generated imagery; copy binds to variant ids.
checks.rule: Body states no Arabic text is baked into generated imagery and copy regions bind to QA-passed copy-package variant ids filled by copywriter-ar in stream 4.

checks.description: Generative or build tool choice runs through build-vs-buy with Arabic as decisive filter.
checks.rule: Body states generative or build tool choice runs through build-vs-buy-eval, Arabic capability is the decisive filter, and no tool is adopted without approval.

checks.description: No invented Skill Path titles or instructor names; one primary action; no personal data in tracking.
checks.rule: Body states no invented Skill Path titles or instructor names, one primary action per view, no personal or sensitive data in tracking, and empowering not deficit-framed.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the skill files.
checks.rule: No file in this skill contains the U+2014 em dash character.
No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669) appear in any file; digits are 0-9 only.

checks.description: No tatweel or kashida in any Arabic text.
checks.rule: No file contains the U+0640 tatweel character.
